name: Kigen Color Generator
summary: Color scale generator that turns one seed color into an 11-shade palette with Tailwind, CSS, SVG and Figma export.
description: A browser color scale generator from Kigen, the Figma design system and plugin by Overlayz Studio. Pick or randomize a base color, then adjust the algorithm, contrast shift, shade count and naming pattern, and copy the resulting scale as CSS, Tailwind, Tailwind 4 or design tokens in HEX, RGBA, HSL or OKLCH, or export it as SVG for Figma.
contains: 11-shade scale (50-950) generated from one seed color
controls: algorithm, contrast shift, shade count, naming pattern
exports: CSS, Tailwind, Tailwind 4, tokens, SVG/Figma
color formats: HEX, RGBA, HSL, OKLCH
